The Advanced Product Search API is a technical challenge Luis Romero completed in July 2026. It is hosted at advanced-search-api-chet.onrender.com/docs and the source code is on github.com/ROMEROLUIS15/advanced-search-api. Luis built a search service that ranks results by relevance rather than insertion order. The ranking uses BM25 on Elasticsearch 8, with typo tolerance, and is adjusted by popularity and recency.
